# LearnFast

> LearnFast delivers evidence-based brain training programs for dyslexia, ADHD, and auditory processing disorders using Fast ForWord technology.

LearnFast is an Australian and New Zealand-based educational platform specializing in neuroscience-backed learning programs. The site provides comprehensive resources for students, teachers, and parents seeking solutions for learning difficulties, supported by over 300 peer-reviewed research studies and programs developed by leading neuroscientists including Merzenich, Jenkins, and Tallal.

## Key Topics

- Fast ForWord
- Dyslexia support
- Auditory Processing Disorder (APD)
- Brain training
- Reading difficulties
- ADHD
- Cognitive development
- Language development
- Reading Assistant
- Adaptive learning
- Educational neuroscience
- Phonics instruction
- Executive function
- Learning difficulties
- Clear Fluency
